title: Relocate the frozen refactor baseline
goal: Move the reviewed P0 baseline into Analysis Stage evidence and its update tools into maintenance without changing frozen generated content.
acceptanceCriteria: The legacy refactor-baseline directory is absent and all frozen data is present under Analysis Stage evidence.
Baseline maintenance tools are present only under maintenance/refactor-baseline and the generator -Check remains byte-identical.
Commands, Stage documentation and living documentation reference the new locations while historical records retain their original paths.
Frozen baseline evidence is excluded from active policy enumeration.
Manifest, documentation, policy-candidate and trusted-component validation pass.
Trusted Diff consumes exact move, policy and TCB authorizations once.
